item.title: Scaling Up Data Governance for AI
item.description: In this video interview, Terry Dorsey, Senior Data Architect and Evangelist at Denodo, discusses rethinking data management in the age of AI.

item.title: Disjointed Data and IT: What That Means and How to Fix It
item.description: When their data sources and fragmented IT systems don't "talk" to each other, agencies lose opportunities for meaningful insights and create new security risks.

item.title: When Your Data Goes Astray…
item.description: There can be serious, costly consequences when agency staff expose sensitive data, even if human error is the cause. Here are tactics to prevent and identify data leaks.

item.title: Can You Track and Trust Your Data?
item.description: It's tough to ensure your data's accuracy and reliability when you've lost track of its origin. Tactics such as metadata management, data stewardship, and traceability audits will help. Learn what they involve.

item.title: Meeting the Burden of Data Compliance
item.description: Compliance rules, although important, can lead to operational and technical headaches, costly investments, and data sharing hurdles. But no matter what state- or industry-specific rules apply, certain best practices can help government teams navigate data compliance mandates.

item.title: Understanding Gov Performance Management Basics
item.description: In our most recent Supervisor Community of Practice virtual networking discussion, we sat down with Patrick S. Malone, Ph.D., Director, Key Executive Leadership Programs, Department of Public Administration and Policy, American University, to discuss how, as a leader, you can polish your performance management skills to better guide your team to meet its goals.

item.title: February’s Online Training Line-Up Is Here
item.description: Love learning? So do we, and we’ve got a great educational online training line-up for February! From data governance and AI policies to softer skills such as team motivation, there’s something for everyone to sign up for.

item.title: What Plain Language Is, and Why We Need It
item.description: Agencies communicate effectively when they use plain language — simple, clear writing rather than fancy words and over-long sentences. Here are tips on writing so your target audience understands.

item.title: Breaking Down Barriers to an AI-Skilled Workforce
item.description: In this video interview, Jonathan Hasak and Aaron Hunter with Coursera discuss how to overcome barriers to fostering an AI-knowledgeable workforce.

item.title: Improve Security With Simplified, Modern Identity Solutions
item.description: In this video interview, Tabitha Hancock, Identity Services General Manager for UberEther, describes how to tighten security by simplifying and modernizing identity controls.
